about.title: The official entry of MAG Color into Europe
about.description: This is the first edition of MAGColor Experience Lisbon. A gathering created to mark MAG Color's official entry into Europe and bring together professionals who want to elevate their technical level, broaden their vision and be part of a new international micropigmentation community.
about.cta: Be Part of the First Edition

why.title: An experience that can mark a before and after in your career
why.subtitle: If you are a micropigmentation artist, PMU professional, trainer or advanced aesthetics specialist, this event is for you.
why.tech_desc: Learn from international professionals who work with precision and an updated vision of aesthetic, capillary and paramedical micropigmentation.
why.prestige_desc: Experience an event where competition, international judges, trophies and the gala transform the experience into real recognition.
why.networking_desc: Connect with artists, trainers, speakers, judges and brands from Brazil, Portugal and Spain.
why.business_desc: Broaden your professional vision, elevate your positioning and understand how to grow in an increasingly competitive industry.

miriam.title: Under the direction of Miriam Alcántara
miriam.bio: Miriam Alcántara is one of the most recognized international references in advanced and paramedical micropigmentation in Europe. With over 30 years of experience, she has trained more than 30,000 students, establishing herself as a mentor, trainer and opinion leader in the industry.
miriam.quote: Her vision goes beyond teaching a technique: she leads a movement to transform micropigmentation artists into more solid, visible and recognized professionals.

venue.title: A privileged location in the heart of Lisbon
venue.address: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, 8, 1269-133 Lisbon, Portugal
venue.hosting_note: Accommodation is only included in the Divine VIP ticket (2 nights in a shared double room with breakfast).

questions.q: What's included in each ticket type?
questions.a: All tickets include access to 2 full days of the event, lectures, simultaneous translation, lunches, access to the White Gala Dinner, welcome kit and certificate. Gold also includes a business kit, preferential seating at the gala and a surprise gift. Divine VIP includes accommodation, private Divine Night dinner, front row and much more.

Accommodation (2 nights in a shared double room with breakfast) is only included in the Divine VIP ticket. Basic and Gold tickets do not include accommodation, but we recommend the HF Fénix Lisbon Hotel, where the event takes place.

Yes! The event features simultaneous Portuguese-Spanish translation. Speakers will present in Portuguese, Spanish, or English, and there will be live translation so all attendees can follow 100% of the content.

The championship has 3 categories: Hair by Hair, Powder/Shaded Eyebrows and Lips. Participants compete with live real models. An international jury evaluates each work and winners are awarded at the White Gala Dinner with trophies, recognition and international visibility.
We accept credit/debit card payment through Stripe. We also offer bank transfer or Bizum payment with an exclusive discount for the first 20 tickets. Contact us via WhatsApp for this option.

questions.q: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
questions.a: In case of cancellation up to 60 days before the event, we refund 50% of the ticket value. After this period, no refund will be possible. However, the spot is transferable: you can assign your ticket to another professional by notifying us by email at least 7 days in advance.

questions.q: How does the training voucher included in the tickets work?
questions.a: Each ticket includes a training voucher equivalent to the ticket value (€497, €797, or €1,297) to be used on Instituto Miriam Alcántara programs. The voucher is personal and non-transferable, valid for 12 months after the event. Check the conditions on the institute's website.
